facts.fact: A National Assembly committee report names SZI's e-Government Master Plan 2018 to 2030 and describes the SMART Zambia goal as in line with it, so the stated period ran 2018-2030 and covered the report's date; it does not describe the plan's scope or give its text. The report is dated by year only (2023, from its internal data as of December 2022). Text public: not stated
